findings.summary: I0, I1, W0, and D0 each completed three clean processes on the physical AMD Vulkan adapter with exact output for all four frozen HoloScript tropical-SpMV topologies. W0 and D0 also reproduced their hash-bound application evidence from persisted replay receipts.

D0 did not produce an independent-correction outcome unavailable from W0. The unchanged pinned incumbent already passes the governed oracle and replay contract, so no P0 correction is required and this diagnostic assigns no unique application value to DoeRuntime.

limitations: Three clean processes per lane remain diagnostic and do not satisfy the promotion reliability floor.
The direct diagnostic reused a prepared upstream workspace and is not a clean production installation receipt.
The exact oracle covers the four frozen tropical-SpMV topologies, not HoloScript's complete WebGPU surface, concurrency, device loss, or bounded memory growth.
P0 is conditional for independent correction and was not required because W0 exposed no release-relevant defect.
Clean-process and receipt-overhead durations are diagnostic; no material performance claim is made.
The result does not justify making HoloScript a DoeRuntime release blocker.

performance.reason: The diagnostic records workload durations but does not run the frozen selected-operation performance protocol.

I0.summary: The ordinary upstream package resolution selected webgpu@0.3.10 and passed three clean oracle runs.

I1.summary: The explicitly version-checked webgpu@0.3.10 incumbent passed three clean oracle runs.

W0.summary: Pinned Dawn under the governed provider, oracle, receipt, and replay contract passed.

D0.summary: DoeRuntime under the identical governed contract passed.

P0.summary: The independent-correction hypothesis requires P0 only when W0 exposes a defect; W0 passed, so no correction was materialized.

materialOutcome.summary: D0 did not materially exceed W0 on the frozen exact-output outcome; both passed every exercised obligation.

costAcceptance.summary: No unique application benefit was measured to repay DoeRuntime's additional source, compatibility, security, packaging, and support obligations.

installation.summary: The diagnostic reused a prepared workspace and direct provider substitution rather than a claim-eligible clean installation path.

supportHardware.summary: Every lane selected the physical Radeon 8060S RADV adapter without software fallback.

concurrency.summary: The diagnostic uses sequential clean processes.

teardown.summary: Processes exited cleanly, but promotion-scale teardown cycles and lifecycle injection were not run.

stress.summary: Promotion-scale stress and device-loss injection were not run.

memory.summary: Peak process memory was recorded, but bounded-growth leak testing was not run.

receipts.summary: The reviewed raw matrix, summary, immutable input chain, and per-provider replay receipts are hash-bound.

replay.summary: W0 and D0 each reproduced the exact frozen application evidence hash from a persisted replay receipt.

performance.summary: No selected-operation performance decision was run.

ownership.summary: The matrix is complete, but D0 supplies no measured independent-correction advantage over W0.

release.summary: HoloScript remains a diagnostic integration and is not a DoeRuntime release blocker.
